data.value: The wizard has 6 steps: profile, list, template, checks, mode and time, confirm. Fix any red warning in the checks step first. Do not forget to send yourself a test.

data.value: The campaigns screen lists all your sends. You can pause, resume or cancel a running campaign. Nobody is sent the same campaign twice.

data.value: The dashboard shows your overall status: active contacts, recent campaigns and warnings to look at. Use the button at the top right to start a new campaign.

data.value: This screen checks your domain's DNS records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX). Red items cause emails to land in spam. Under each item you will find what to do and a sample record to add to your DNS panel.

data.value: Choose your file, check the columns and tick 'These people gave explicit consent'. The app automatically separates invalid, duplicate, disposable and previously unsubscribed addresses.

data.name: Help_ListDetail
data.value: Search the people in the list and filter by status. 'History' shows which campaigns went to that person.

data.name: Help_Lists
data.value: Lists hold the people you send to. Drag a CSV or Excel file onto the window or use 'Import list'. Addresses on the suppression list never receive any campaign.

data.name: Help_ProfileEdit
data.value: Pick your provider first; server settings are filled in for you. The sender address should be on your own domain (for example news@yourcompany.com). Passwords are kept in your computer's secure store. Keep the warm-up plan on for new domains.

data.value: A sender profile defines which account and server your emails are sent from. Each profile has daily, hourly and per-minute limits. Use 'Test connection' to verify the details.

data.name: Help_Reports
data.value: Reports show sends, bounces, unsubscribes and complaints per campaign. Keep the complaint rate below 0.1% and the bounce rate below 2%.

data.name: Help_Settings
data.value: Settings holds language, test addresses, the unsubscribe server, privacy actions, backups and the support bundle. Sending speed is under 'Advanced'; the defaults are safe.

data.name: Help_Setup

If the From address is empty, the user name is used. For Microsoft 365, app passwords only work if your admin allows them.
